title: MFD No.10 T3-DT01 independent timing check - PREPARATION ONLY; NOT AN EXECUTION PERMIT

aggregator: single process (workers compute only; no file writes)

composition.aux0: ns{5,2,12} x a=0 x seeds 0-19 at D_max=500 = 60

aux_timing.status: PREPARATION ONLY - independent two-trial table; requires separate signed authorization before execution

retention.algorithm: u=int.from_bytes(SHA256('{seed}:{trial_key}')[:8],'big')/2**64; optional full trajectory iff u<0.10 and not mandatory; result-independent; one full file per trial

main.time_enforced_by: OS watchdog (mfd_rbsh_v2_supervisor.py): kills the whole process group at min(per-launch limit, remaining cumulative budget)
main.time_s_meaning: time_s = per-launch limit; also the default cumulative budget (the authorization record may carry a signed cumulative_time_budget_s, only larger than this value by a NEW approval that supersedes the earlier one)

aux.time_enforced_by: OS watchdog (mfd_rbsh_v2_supervisor.py): kills the whole process group at min(per-launch limit, remaining cumulative budget)
aux.time_s_meaning: time_s = per-launch limit; also the default cumulative budget (the authorization record may carry a signed cumulative_time_budget_s, only larger than this value by a NEW approval that supersedes the earlier one)

budgets.note_aux_budget: aux 2.5 h / 1.5 GB taken from the instruction plan; soft = 90% of hard (same ratio as 4.5/5 GB)
budgets.time_operation: Method C (OS watchdog + progress monitoring). aux_timing.status: PROPOSED PREPARATION BUDGET; not an authorization

roles.soft_limit: operating limit: store decisions (optional skipped first) and pre-run prediction
roles.hard_limit: absolute ceiling: periodic end-state scan; exceeding stops safely

completion_states.INCOMPLETE: computed but mandatory storage not finished; reprocessed

storage_rules.full: M2 (byte-shuffle + LZMA preset 6; per-array and container SHA-256; tmp+fsync+os.replace; read-back verify)
storage_rules.ledger: append-only; torn lines preserved in ledger_torn.jsonl

stop_conditions: mandatory full trajectory cannot be stored (capacity / free disk / write failure) -> safe stop after writing a non-COMPLETE ledger row
prediction + used > soft limit at start
resume_conditions: rerun same command; done set = COMPLETE ledger rows only; torn ledger lines preserved; orphan files reused/quarantined; attempts and previous_states recorded

environment.thread_determinism_check: 2 trials, OPENBLAS threads 1/2/default: identical array SHA-256 (thread_determinism.txt); limited (2 cores)

driver: mfd_rbsh_v2_supervisor.py is the only entry point for execution (it launches mfd_rbsh_v2_run_driver.py --execute); the driver alone refuses --execute (default dry-run incl. freeze-manifest verification). Key via MFD_RBSH_AUTH_KEY/--key-file.

authorization_guard.issuer_tool: mfd_rbsh_v2_auth_tool.py (research lead only: keygen / issue / verify)
record_binds: optional signed fields: cumulative_time_budget_s, supersedes_approval_ids, revocation_ledger_id (each signed only when present)
authorization_guard.signature: HMAC-SHA256 with a secret key held by the research lead and supplied at run time (not stored in the repository)
checks_at_execute: freeze manifest covers table and execution manifest
output directory bound to one set and one approval id (RUN_START events)
cumulative budget in record equals manifest budget unless the record supersedes an earlier approval
execution only through a supervised launch
authorization_guard.limits: stops accidental, stale, mismatched or key-less executions; cannot stop someone who holds both key and files

ledger_rules.legacy_or_foreign_rows: run refused (LedgerFormatError), nothing written or reinterpreted
ledger_rules.complete_row_trust: COMPLETE rows are re-verified on resume (tier-1 size, full-trajectory existence and SHA-256, mandatory stored); failures are demoted to INTERRUPTED and re-run
ledger_rules.free_space_unknown: treated as not storable: safe stop / refusal to start

time_operation.approval_status: PROPOSED - NOT APPROVED by the research lead
time_operation.audit_file: watchdog_audit.jsonl (hash-chained, append-only, in the run directory)
time_operation.extra_time: requires a new signed authorization record (cumulative_time_budget_s + supersedes_approval_ids) issued by the research lead; the run directory stays bound to the superseded lineage
time_operation.on_budget_reached: whole process group stopped (SIGTERM, then SIGKILL after grace), STOP_REQUESTED/STOP_DONE/LAUNCH_END recorded, extension_request_data.json/.md written (completed/remaining/ETA/storage); no condition or convergence change
time_operation.on_abnormal_supervisor_end: children die with the supervisor (PR_SET_PDEATHSIG); open session counted conservatively at next start (STALE_SESSION_DETECTED); progress monitor raises ALERT
time_operation.driver_gate: run driver --execute only as a direct child of an open supervised launch of the same set
limits: a process that deliberately escapes the process group (setsid) is not contained
host suspend/clock jumps are not modelled (monotonic clock)
someone holding key and files can still bypass; this is not an access-control system

main.rule: the first 10 h budget is not changed without the research lead's decision
main.estimate_h: 8.6-14.3 (estimate; recent controller-path measurement ~12.5 h => completion within 10 h is NOT expected)
main.extension: new signed authorization with cumulative_time_budget_s > used time and supersedes_approval_ids; never resets used time
main.resume: same command with the new authorization; COMPLETE rows re-verified; revocation + budget re-checked

aux.limited_measurement: 33 cells x 1 trial; real computation only after approval B

time_budget_design_rev5.clocks: limits use time.monotonic; wall-clock t_utc is recorded in the audit

approvals.independence: main and aux have their own approval id, signature, time budget and revocation state

revocation.status: IMPLEMENTED in rev5 and self-tested with test keys / mock authorizations only (no real key or record exists). Not independently re-run by a third party.
revocation.modules: mfd_rbsh_v2_revocation.py (ledger), run_guard (revocation_ledger_id field), auth_tool (revoke-init / revoke / revocation-status; research lead only), supervisor (periodic check), run_driver (re-check)
revocation.ledger: mfd_rbsh_v2_revocations.jsonl next to this manifest (default); append-only JSON lines; record 0 GENESIS (ledger_id); REVOKE records {approval_id,set,issue_id,revoked_at_utc,reason,authorized_by,seq (=version),prev,sha256,mac(HMAC-SHA256 with the authorization key)}
revocation.binding: each authorization carries the signed field revocation_ledger_id; a ledger with another id is refused (LEDGER_MISMATCH)
fail_closed_codes: LEDGER_ROLLBACK (older than the head recorded in the run audit)
AMBIGUOUS (same approval_id, different set or issue_id)
revocation.revoking_an_old_approval: revoking an approval id does not block a newer, separately issued authorization (e.g. an extension that supersedes it); only the presented authorization's own approval id is checked

midrun.transient_read_retry: 3 tries x 0.2 s (REVOKED/AMBIGUOUS/MISMATCH/ROLLBACK/NO_KEY are not retried)
midrun.max_detection_delay_s: design bound: poll 5.0 + retry 0.4 + check time (one test run with poll 0.5 s: detected 0.02 s after the revocation append)
midrun.stop: whole process group SIGTERM then SIGKILL after grace (default 5 s); exit code 12; stop reason REVOKED or REVOCATION_UNVERIFIABLE_<code>
midrun.max_time_to_stop_s: design bound with defaults: about 5.4 + 5 + 5 = ~15 s (one test run: launch ended 0.21 s after detection)

limits: a holder of both key and files can rewrite the ledger consistently; rollback is only detectable against a head already recorded in the run audit
revocation is checked at launch and every poll interval; work done in the detection window is kept (COMPLETE rows verified on resume)
does not hide revocations; not an access-control system
